title: 'Just $189/month' display banner (V2)
text:
One simple payment.

Just $189/month.*

No origination fee. Apply today.

*Example: a $5,000 loan repaid in 36 monthly payments of $188.99 has a 21.24% APR. Rates from 8.99% to 24.99% APR.
notes: Revision pair, V2 of display-payment-v1: the trigger-term disclosures are complete (fixed), the rate is stated as an APR (fixed) and 'Instant approval' is gone (fixed), but 'No origination fee' is new and false (PL-1 charges 1% to 5%). The example's payment is computed from the stated APR with no fee, so it is internally consistent.
